### Problem statement
What gap does this fill? Why can't it be done today?

### Proposed behavior
Describe the feature and any new CLI flags / endpoints.

### Core vs. Enterprise
Per the feature-gate matrix, is this deterministic, stdlib-only, single-node, offline, and
< 1 ms? If it needs embeddings, SSO, multi-tenancy, SaaS SDKs, or exporters, it belongs in
`finops-proxy-ee` instead.

### Alternatives considered
Any workarounds or rejected approaches.
